scope: Isolated native Harmonika UI/API/SQLite tenant application and SQLite backup/restore; real backend decision probes and guarded firewall activation

roles.Codex: Prepared native exams, reproduced and implemented backend fix, verified independent results and activated the reviewed candidate.
roles.OpenCode: Pure plan-mode read-only contract and firewall review; no Claude invoked.

qa_review.observed_answer: Reports six API tests and twelve supplied extended browser checks, explicitly says these are not held-out tests, points to actual screenshots and acknowledges fixture warnings.
qa_review.visual_review: Codex inspected actual independent 1280x800 and 360x640 screenshots: controls visible, no horizontal overflow, hostile-looking title rendered literally.

qa_review.observed_answer: Reports seven tests, consistent committed WAL snapshot, exclusion of uncommitted rows, hash/integrity checks, explicit replace permission, sidecar/symlink refusal and atomic publication. Power-loss/race limitations remain explicit.
qa_review.self_correction: Agent reproduced WAL integrity failures, corrected connection closure and snapshot journal handling, then rechecked successfully.

backend_fix.initial_observation: Two app runs terminated with public 502 engine_error; contemporaneous mechanical backend events reported tool_secret_reference_required.
backend_fix.reproduction: The baseline rejected source that concatenates the nonsecret Bearer scheme with a runtime variable/property reference. The first correction still rejected the template literal form.
backend_fix.diagnostic_limit: Rejected model decision contents were not retained; exact rejected calls and the full public error-normalization path were not reconstructed. Independent synthetic repros establish the false-positive classes; this does not claim all engine_error causes are fixed.
backend_fix.implemented: Recognize only Authorization colon with Bearer prefix concatenation or one template interpolation of an identifier/property/unquoted identifier index, followed by a complete-value delimiter. Preserve this nonsecret source in tool receipts too.
still_rejected: Literal bearer credentials and known key formats
Function calls or quoted lookups in the special reference grammar
Secret-file paths, environment dumps and replay of redaction markers
backend_fix.regression_results: All passed; Linux integration used the actual staged planner with real AJV/firewall and stubbed generation, without executing client tools.

activation.guards: Two idle observations, baseline/candidate hash checks, private backup, atomic replacement, health check and rollback path; unrelated web/shared-core PIDs unchanged.

production_model_checks.limits: Decision probes test selected behavior only. They do not execute browser, backup or restore on production.

acceptance_review.timing: OpenCode reviewed frozen contracts after native runs started. Examiner corrections were applied to independent grading before the initial results were finalized; native protected contracts/tools were not changed.

changes: Accept ValueError or BackupError for ambiguous manifest path traversal input
Remove unstated assertion that missing source leaves no new backup directory
Independent browser requires exact done toggle status and no img DOM injection

acceptance_review.firewall_review: OpenCode reviewed a snapshot with newline as a value delimiter. Codex had removed that delimiter and added a multiline regression before first activation; subsequent tests also pin dot-continuation, prefix scope and delimiter cases. Review had no file-write or shell action.
acceptance_review.reusable_harness_fixes: Future fixtures clarify manifest path error wording, require exact done state, verify no injected img element, and close owned Python pipes/HTTP responses. A separate cloned fixture passed six tests with ResourceWarning enabled and no ResourceWarning. Frozen native tools retain the original warning; it is disclosed rather than silently patched.
acceptance_review.retest_evidence: First failed retest manually archived before second retest. Reusable runner now allocates numbered retest names and refuses to overwrite an initial run.

browser_artifacts.method: Owned headless Chromium 156.0.8078.4, loopback random-port server, viewport emulation; no user browser/profile

limits: App and backup code are synthetic exam artifacts; production billing/CS apps and real databases were not modified or certified.
Fixture bearer references are fake; production authentication/session architecture is outside this test.
Mobile uses browser viewport emulation, not physical device, IME or mobile OS testing.
No power-loss/process-crash, comprehensive hostile filesystem race, multi-writer load, universal XSS/security or full auth syntax certification.
Generic public policy/error normalization to engine_error remains outside this correction; exact rejected decisions were not logged.
No blanket credential whitelist, mutation replay, automatic model training or TUI binary/branding change.
